summary: Frontend-only retest of the receipt-upload follow-ups. Ran Playwright on mobile (390x844) as vc.driver against claim c47ace2f (draft). (the generic 'Could not read those receipts' text is gone). Snap with good.jpg + bad.heic gives 200 + 415; one line is added and the banner reads 'Some receipts didn't upload: That photo format couldn't be read — please take the receipt photo again.' PASS. FIX3: after the Snap failure with the page scrolled to the top, the exp-error banner is in the viewport (y=601 of 844; y=585 for the mixed-batch case). PASS. There are 4 receipt thumbnails for 4 lines. Save draft persisted all 4 lines with receipt_ids (checked in the DB). PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: snapNewReceipts keeps only the last failDetail, so different failures in one batch (e.g. 413 + 415) show only one reason. Acceptable.

On a mixed batch, line 227 overwrites the lowscan/duplicate warning with 'Some receipts didn't upload'. This is intended priority, but the user loses the 'hard to read' hint for the line that was added (the line itself is still flagged).
